heading: How would you like to get started?

upload.text: Upload lesson slides, worksheets or <u>any document</u>
upload.hint: PDF, DOCX, TXT or images · up to 50 MB · AI turns it into questions

import.title: Import your questions
import.sub: Already have a question list? Bring it in exactly as you wrote it.

standards.title: Create with Standards or Curriculum
standards.text: Describe a standard (e.g. CCSS.MATH.5.NF.A.1) and let AI write aligned questions.
standards.topic: Create questions aligned to this curriculum standard:

modal.title: Import from spreadsheet
modal.step1: Download the template and fill it in with Excel or Google Sheets.
modal.step2: Supported types: Multiple Choice, Checkbox, True/False, Fill-in-the-Blank, Open-Ended, Poll, Reorder.
modal.step3: Correct answer: option number(s) like 2 or 1,3; for fill-in-the-blank, separate alternatives with |.
modal.step4: Save as CSV and upload it here.
